description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc class, which interacts with IPC mechanisms to query media pipeline capabilities such as supported MIME types. It uses Google Test framework for testing various scenarios including success, failure, and disconnection handling.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc interactions, inheriting from IpcModuleBase and Google Test's Test class. It provides setup methods and mock responses for testing IPC calls related to media capabilities.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Initializes the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc object and expects IPC to be initialized successfully.

methods.name: setGetSupportedMimeTypesResponse
methods.description: Populates the response message with supported MIME types for testing.

methods.name: setIsMimeTypeSupportedResponse
methods.description: Sets the response message to indicate a MIME type is supported.
